reading_budget.method: 🔴 COUNTED BY READING THE CAPTIONS, NOT BY A PARSER, AND THAT IS THE CORRECTION. Figure 1 A-F, Figure 2 A-D, Figure 3 A-F, Figure 4 A-F, Figure 5 A-G, Figure 6 A-F, Figure 7 A-D = 39. Three successive ad-hoc scripts gave 7, then 9, then 6 for this article, each time by a matcher that failed and returned a plausible small number instead of an error. `figures_present` derived from the paper means read the captions; it never meant wait for a parser to be able to count. The budget is a means, not a gate.
reading_budget.figure_surface: The publisher PDF is the figure surface and the PMC HTML remains the text surface; the two are not mixed. Seven images, one per figure, at 213-306 effective ppi across a 7-inch page, every one with smask = 0 so extraction returns what the page shows. PMC serves nothing comparable for this article.

field_density.note: ITCH appears 10 times in the discovery ledger, 5 in the dismissal ledger, once in the claim registry and twice in the paper registry. The state already knows the K63 linkage and the K274 site — DEFAULTS THAT BIT US carries D-01 'polyubiquitination → proteasome' as a falsified default, and DIS-001 was reopened on exactly this biology. What it does NOT carry, anywhere, is the direction: that ITCH ubiquitination STABILISES WWOX. Every existing statement treats ITCH as something one might inhibit, and correctly advises against it.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PREMISE THE STATE IMPORTS AT SECOND HAND, DEMONSTRATED HERE FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THIS CORPUS FROM ITS PRIMARY SOURCE. Mass spectrometry identified two ubiquitinated lysines, Lys-100 and Lys-274, and site-directed mutagenesis separated them: K274R abolished ITCH-mediated ubiquitination while K100R did not. DL-MECH-083 rests on PMID 25331887 importing K274 and ITCH without demonstrating either; this is the demonstration.
entries.snippet: these data suggest that ITCH predominantly mediates polyubiquitination of WWOX at Lys-274
entries.anchor: Results, end of the section on ITCH-mediated ubiquitination of WWOX
entries.found_or_sought: sought — this is the sentence the reading was assigned to find

entries.proposition: THE MUTANT RESULT ITSELF, AND ITS COMPARATOR, RECORDED BECAUSE THE COMPARATOR IS WHAT THE CLAIM RESTS ON. K274R is judged against GST-WWOX-WFPA — the WW1-dead construct that cannot bind ITCH at all — so the claim is that K274R behaves like a non-binder, not merely that it is reduced against wild type. That is the stronger reading and it is the one the sentence supports.
entries.snippet: the WWOX-K274R mutant was not as compared with the WWOX-WFPA construct
entries.anchor: Results, immediately before the Lys-274 conclusion; the constructs are listed in the caption of Figure 5G
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I went looking for what K274R was compared against before accepting 'predominantly'

entries.proposition: AND THE QUALIFICATION THE WORD 'PREDOMINANTLY' CARRIES. Lys-100 is not eliminated: ITCH still ubiquitinates the K100R mutant, at reduced efficiency. So K274 is the major site and not the only one, and any downstream statement that treats WWOX ubiquitination as a single-site event is over-reading this paper.
entries.snippet: ITCH could still ubiquitinate the WWOX-K100R mutant, although to a lesser extent
entries.anchor: Results, the sentence after the K274R result
entries.found_or_sought: found — read in sequence

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE LINKAGE, WHICH IS THE PAPER BEHIND THIS REPOSITORY'S D-01 FALSIFIED DEFAULT. DEFAULTS THAT BIT US records 'polyubiquitination → proteasome' as false because K48 and K63 differ; this is the primary measurement underneath that entry, and until tonight it had never been read here.
entries.snippet: We found that ITCH-mediated WWOX ubiquitination is predominantly Lys-63-linked
entries.anchor: Results, opening of the section 'ITCH Mediates Lys-63-linked Ubiquitination of WWOX'
entries.found_or_sought: sought — the linkage is the load-bearing half of the premise

entries.proposition: THE LINKAGE CLAIM IS PROPERLY CONTROLLED, WHICH IS WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE ANTIBODY-BASED LINKAGE CALLS OFTEN ARE NOT. A positive control was run for the K48 antibody using a protein whose K48-linked proteasomal degradation is established, and it behaved as expected — detected by the K48 antibody and not the K63 one.
entries.snippet: we overexpressed HIF1α, a well known protein that undergoes proteasomal degradation that is Lys-48-linked
entries.anchor: Results, the antibody validation immediately after the Lys-63 claim; the experiment is Figure 6B
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I looked for the antibody control before accepting a linkage call made with antibodies

entries.proposition: AND AN ORTHOGONAL CONFIRMATION THAT DOES NOT DEPEND ON ANTIBODIES AT ALL. Ubiquitin constructs in which every lysine but one is mutated to arginine give the linkage genetically rather than immunologically, and they agree. Two independent methods for one conclusion is why this linkage call can carry weight downstream.
entries.snippet: we used HA-Ub constructs that are either Lys-63 only or Lys-48 only (all other lysines are mutated to arginines)
entries.anchor: Results, the confirmation of the Lys-63 linkage; the experiment is Figure 6C
entries.found_or_sought: found — read in sequence, and it is the sentence that upgrades the linkage from suggestive to established

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE DIRECTION, AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT UBIQUITINATION USUALLY IMPLIES. Cycloheximide chase: ITCH does not shorten WWOX's half-life, it EXTENDS it. This is the measurement that makes the K48/K63 distinction consequential rather than taxonomic, and the reason the paper's own framing is that ubiquitination here is not a degradation signal.
entries.snippet: Expression of ITCH in the presence of CHX extended the half-life of WWOX as compared with CHX alone
entries.anchor: Results, the cycloheximide experiment; the panel is Figure 6D
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I went looking for what the K63 chain DOES, because a linkage without a consequence is a taxonomy

entries.proposition: 🔴 AND THE LOSS-OF-FUNCTION SIDE OF THE SAME CLAIM, WHICH IS THE HALF THAT MAKES IT A DEPENDENCY RATHER THAN AN OVEREXPRESSION ARTEFACT. In Itch-knockout mouse embryonic fibroblasts WWOX protein is reduced, and its half-life is shortened. So endogenous ITCH is required to sustain endogenous WWOX levels — measured in cells that never saw a transfection.
entries.snippet: We found that WWOX levels were decreased in Itch
entries.anchor: Results, the Itch-knockout MEF experiment; the panels are Figure 6E and 6F
entries.found_or_sought: sought — an overexpression result needed a loss-of-function counterpart before I would carry the direction downstream

entries.proposition: THE HALF-LIFE STATEMENT IN THE AUTHORS' OWN WORDS, QUOTED SEPARATELY BECAUSE IT IS THE QUANTITATIVE HALF OF THE PREVIOUS ENTRY. Level and half-life are different measurements and the paper reports both; conflating them is how an abundance claim quietly becomes a stability claim.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE AUTHORS STATE IT AS A NEGATIVE, AND THIS IS THE SENTENCE THE CANONICAL STATE DOES NOT CARRY. Ubiquitination here is explicitly uncoupled from degradation. Every ITCH statement in this repository's canonical files treats ITCH as something one might INHIBIT — DIS-001 reopened it as an experimental probe and advised against inhibition because that would strip WWOX of its DDR function. None of them records that ITCH activity RAISES WWOX abundance, which points the lever in the opposite direction.
entries.snippet: ITCH ubiquitinates WWOX independent of degradation
entries.anchor: Discussion, the paragraph summarising the WWOX-ITCH interaction
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I read the Discussion for the authors' own framing after the CHX and knockout results pointed the same way

entries.proposition: 🔴 AND THE POSITIVE FORM OF THE SAME SENTENCE, WHICH IS THE ONE WITH THERAPEUTIC CONSEQUENCES. INFERENZA, and it converges two open premises onto one experiment: DIS-003 rejects 'boosting WWOX expression' BECAUSE the bottleneck lies downstream of transcription — and ITCH-mediated K63 ubiquitination is a downstream handle on WWOX abundance, which is precisely the arm that rejection leaves open. Whether the handle is on-target for the reference genotype depends on the disjunction DL-META-091 could not resolve: if Q230P protein is absent through PREMATURE DEGRADATION, a stabilising lever is on-target; if through IMPAIRED TRANSLATION, there is nothing for ITCH to stabilise. The same western that discriminates those two arms also decides whether ITCH is a lever.
entries.snippet: coexpression of WWOX and ITCH stabilizes WWOX levels and enhances p73-mediated cell death
entries.anchor: Discussion, the same paragraph, immediately after the degradation-independence statement
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I was looking for whether the authors themselves name a functional consequence of the stabilisation

The sentence names the alternative roles explicitly — DNA damage repair, kinase activation, trafficking — which is the vocabulary D-01 uses.
entries.snippet: Because Lys-48 linkages are mostly associated with commitment for proteasomal degradation, whereas Lys-63-linked polyubiquitination plays established roles in DNA damage repair, protein kinase activation, and trafficking

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE CAPTION OF FIGURE 5 CANNOT SAY WHICH PANEL SHOWS THE K274 SPECTRUM, AND K274 IS THE RESIDUE THE WHOLE PREMISE RESTS ON. The caption announces the two MS/MS spectra as panels 'E and F', then labels them in parentheses as '(C)' and '(D)' — and C and D are already assigned earlier in the same caption to the ITCH-mutant ubiquitination blot and the Coomassie/MS pull-down. A following clause adds '(E)' for the ion colouring. Four labels for two spectra, two of them reused. The running text resolves it — it cites 'Fig. 5, E and F' for the two peptides — so the finding is safe; but a reader who goes to the panel named in the legend for the K274 spectrum is sent to a blot of something else.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PANEL I FLAGGED AS THE PLACE A FIGURE COULD OVERTURN THE TEXT — AND IT UPHOLDS IT. Figure 5G was recorded an hour ago as the debt of this reading: a densitometry-free negative on a western, carrying the residue the whole premise rests on. Inspected at 272 ppi and cropped to 780 ppi equivalent, the anti-HA pull-down shows a strong ubiquitination ladder only in WWOX+ITCH; the K274R+ITCH lane sits at the level of the WFPA+ITCH binding-dead control, while the K100R+ITCH lane carries a clear, weaker ladder. Exactly what the text claims. AND IT CORRECTED ME IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION FROM THIS MORNING: at whole-figure scale I had read a faint smear into the K274R lane. The FLAG row confirms ITCH is expressed in all four +ITCH lanes, so lane 6's absence is not an absent ligase. THE CAVEAT THAT REMAINS IS INPUT: the GST rows show the K274R construct expressed and recovered at a visibly lower level than the others, GAPDH is even across lanes, and no densitometry is given — so the comparison is not input-matched even though its comparator behaves correctly.

Eight lysate lanes labelled WWOX, WWOX+ITCH W.T., WWOX-WFPA, WWOX-WFPA+ITCH, WWOXK274R, WWOXK274R+ITCH, WWOXK100R, WWOXK100R+ITCH, over rows GST, FLAG and GAPDH; below, a Pull Down block with an anti-HA blot marked 250, 150, 75, 50 and an arrow at 'Ubiqui. GST-WWOX', and a GST loading row. In the anti-HA blot a dense high-molecular-weight ladder appears only in lane 2; lane 8 carries a clear weaker ladder; lanes 4 and 6 are near-blank and comparable to each other. FLAG bands are present in lanes 2, 4, 6 and 8. In the GST lysate row lanes 5 and 6 are visibly fainter than the others while GAPDH is even.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE FIGURE SETTLES ITS OWN LEGEND'S COLLISION, WHICH IS STRONGER THAN THE RUNNING TEXT SETTLING IT. The legend of Figure 5 announces the two MS/MS spectra as panels 'E and F' and then labels them '(C)' and '(D)' — letters already assigned earlier in the same legend. Printed on the figure itself, panel E is the K100 peptide LAFTVDDNPTK PTTR with Xcorr 1.54 and MH+ 1789.913, and panel F is the K274 peptide FTDINDSLGK LDFSR with Xcorr 2.11 and MH+ 1841.913, each with the diglycine remnant marked GG above the modified lysine. So the panel letters are E and F, the running text's 'Fig. 5, E and F' is right, and the parenthetical (C)/(D) in the legend is the error. The K274 spectrum also carries the better score of the two.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE PANEL PRINTS THE NUMBER THE RUNNING TEXT WITHHOLDS. The Results say only that 'WWOX levels were decreased' in Itch-knockout fibroblasts. Panel 6E prints the densitometry under the blot: wild type 1, knockout 0.36. A 64% reduction in steady-state WWOX from deleting a single E3 ligase is a quantitative statement about how much of WWOX's abundance depends on ITCH, and it is the number a downstream lever argument needs. Panel 6D likewise quantifies the half-life claim: with cycloheximide alone WWOX falls to about 23% at 3 h and 5% at 6 h, with ITCH to about 51% and 39%, both marked significant.

Panel E: a three-row blot WT versus KO for ITCH, WWOX and GAPDH, with '1' printed under the WT lane and '0.36' under the KO lane. Panel F: MEF-WT and MEF-ITCH-KO at CHX 0, 2, 4, 6 h with ITCH, WWOX and GAPDH rows, beside a bar chart normalised to MEF-WT untreated = 100 in which the knockout bars start near 45 and fall to about 20.

entries.proposition: 🔴 TWO DIFFERENT p-VALUES FOR THE SAME COMPARISON, ONE IN THE METHODS AND ONE PRINTED ON THE PANEL. The Methods state the phage-display enrichment as 'p value <2.2E−18 using rank sum test'. Figure 2D prints, in its own title, 'p-value: 7.5591721538234e-12'. Both describe the same test — the position-weight-matrix scores of WWOX-interacting proteins against the human proteome by rank sum. The conclusion is unaffected at either value; the discrepancy is recorded because a statistic that appears twice with two values cannot both times have come from the analysis that was run.

A red series legended 'WWOX interacting proteins (MS)' lies to the right of a black curve legended 'All Human Proteome'.

entries.proposition: THE MOTIF TREE'S COUNTS CANNOT BE RECONCILED WITH ITS STATED DENOMINATOR WITHOUT AN ASSUMPTION NOBODY STATES. Both the legend and the Methods give the sets as 240 proteins (MS-SET-1) and 144 (MS-SET-2), and describe each number beside a logo as 'the number of proteins with the motif from our mass spectrometry data'. The leaf counts sum to 563 in panel A and 355 in panel B — a factor of 2.35 and 2.47 over their stated sets. The natural reading is that a protein bearing several motifs is counted at several leaves, which is reasonable and is nowhere said; on the literal reading the arithmetic does not close. Recorded as an arithmetic observation, not as an error claim.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE UBIQUITINATION ASSAY IS DESCRIBED AS 'TREATED OR UNTREATED' WITH A PROTEASOME INHIBITOR, AND NO PANEL SAYS WHICH IT WAS. The Methods for the in vivo ubiquitination assay state that after 24 h cells were treated or untreated with MG-132 for 4 h. Only one figure legend in the paper names MG-132 — Figure 6B, the HIF1alpha antibody control. So for Figures 5A-G and 6A and 6C, whether a proteasome inhibitor was present is not recoverable. That matters here more than usual: the paper's central claim is that this ubiquitination is degradation-independent, and a proteasome inhibitor changes how much conjugate accumulates. It does not undermine the K63 linkage or the half-life results, which are separate experiments; it does mean the ubiquitination blots cannot be compared with each other for conjugate abundance.
entries.snippet: After 24 h, cells were treated or untreated with MG-132 (20 μmol/liter; Sigma-Aldrich) for 4 h
